name: neural-seam
description: Neural Seam host adapter for the OpenAI Codex CLI. Registers the neural-seam-runtime MCP server and the $neural-seam:ns-* skills for project onboarding and the day-to-day work loop. Requires the neural-seam binary on PATH.

interface.shortDescription: Your project's spec, conventions and backlog, served to Codex over MCP.
interface.longDescription: Neural Seam coordinates AI-assisted development: your project's spec, glossary, backlog, cards and per-path conventions live in Neural Seam and are served to the agent through MCP, instead of being reconstructed from the file tree every session. This bundle registers the neural-seam-runtime MCP server and adds the $neural-seam:ns-* skills for getting set up and working through cards. Neural Seam provides no model and runs no inference of its own.
defaultPrompt: Use $neural-seam:ns-start to set up this project.
Use $neural-seam:ns-list to see what is on the board.
